# Which EU packaging rules (PPWR) reach your packaging, and by when?

> Free EU Packaging and Packaging Waste Regulation (PPWR, 2025/40) checker for brand owners, importers and online sellers: which duties reach your packaging, when each applies (producer registration, PFAS limits, label, recyclability, recycled content, 50 percent empty-space rule), and what is still open.

Free and open source (MIT). Results are estimates from the numbers typed in, not legal, tax, financial or professional advice.
